target_customer: Independent liquor and wine store owners in the US
problem: Independent liquor stores run on generic or dated POS tools that handle receiving, purchase orders, theft, shipping compliance and online sales poorly. Santé offers one liquor specific system.
business_model: B2B SaaS POS subscription with payments, ecommerce and delivery integrations
product_category: Vertical POS and retail operating system for liquor stores

founders.name: Darren Fike
founders.background_notes: YC page says 10 years of sales and marketing at startups and top sales rep at his last two. Education not listed.

founders.name: Antoine (surname not given)
previous_startups: Multiple startups in robotics, e-commerce and SaaS (outcomes not given)
founders.background_notes: Originally from France per YC page.

competitors.name: KORONA POS
competitors.what: Cloud POS with a liquor store product line

technical_complexity.rationale: A full POS with inventory, receiving, payments, state shipping compliance and RFID theft monitoring is broad engineering work, though mostly standard components for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: POS replacement is disruptive for stores, and POS plus payments plus ecommerce integrations raise switching costs. Liquor specific compliance helps, but general POS vendors also sell to liquor stores.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated source shows incumbents copying the wedge through 2026. Competitors named in 2023 era material are liquor specific vendors such as KORONA.

market_need_then: The company cites more than 34,000 independent liquor stores in the US and describes a roughly $100 billion independent store industry (press releases, 2026). Pain points listed on the YC page at founding include receiving, theft and compliance on shipping.

branding.domain_note: Uses santehq.com rather than sante.com, which suggests the exact domain was not available. No purchase story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and benefit led: ease of use, white glove onboarding, transparent pricing

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press, mascot or community found. The French word for health or cheers fits a drinks vertical, but a name search returns many unrelated companies named Sante.

outcome_analysis: Santé grew from a liquor store POS into an AI operating system for wine and spirits retail, raising a seed in February 2026 and a larger Series A in October 2026. The company claims nearly 1,000 retailers and about $2 billion of annual gross merchandise volume. Success factors cited here are an unusually focused vertical, a CEO who worked in a wine shop while researching the problem, and sticky POS contracts, though traction figures are self reported.
notes: Seed investor lists differ: the company blog names TipTop and angels Ian Crosby and Luke Sophinos, while its About page names UpHonest Capital and press names Veridical Ventures. AlleyWatch reports total funding of $22.6 million. Funding before 2026 (YC standard deal and any earlier checks) not found, so coverage is partial. Founding year 2022 per CB Insights, 2023 per YC. Competitor evidence dated near the batch is thin: City Hive and others were found but their pages are undated, so only KORONA with an August 2023 PDF is listed. Traction numbers are company reported.
